about: Standing people drawn from the Codex people-engine v2 set (art/people-engine/v2): which of its outfits a person wears where, by role, and how tall each age band stands. An official at a government place wears an official's outfit, someone at their own workplace wears work clothes, anyone else their age band's everyday clothes. The set paints adults only, in the outfits base (tee and shorts), shirt, vest and blazer standing. Heights are presentation sizes, TUNABLE by eye.

roomFronts.about: Rooms with a front people face (a rostrum, a dais, a bench, a board): the front's x, in percent of the picture. Everyone in the room turns toward it, seen from behind where their spot faces away. Read from each painting.

seatRoles.about: A seat a room keeps for an office, by the office kind on its records: the role a mannequin plate tags on the spot (art/people-rooms/spots). The holder takes it when present; anyone else may sit there when it is free.

poseReach.about: How near (percent of the picture, across and down) a pose's painted head must be to a spot's head for a person on that spot to take the pose (art/people-rooms/poses: each pose is cut from its room's painting at its own place). TUNABLE by eye, 2 to 6: the art session's pose plates and room plates put the same furniture's person within about 3.5 across and 3 down.
